title: Turkish Airlines Bets Big on Boeing While China Ghosts Them, Frontier's CEO Points Fingers, and Tulum's Airport Dream Dies
summary: Turkish Airlines just placed a massive order for the 737 MAX right as Boeing's hopes for a Chinese mega-deal quietly fall apart. Plus, Frontier's CEO blames credit card companies for his airline's struggles, Lufthansa's social media team picks a fight it can't win, and Tulum's brand-new airport turns out to be a very expensive ghost town.
